en.description:
Radio Tune is a live radio player. It opens straight to the stations people are listening to right now, and everything works without an account.

—— Listen ——

WORLDWIDE
Over 50,000 working stations from 241 countries, drawn from the open Radio Browser directory. Stations flagged as broken are filtered out before you ever see them.

BY GENRE
Music, news and talk, browsable by tag.

NEAR YOU
Allow location once and Radio Tune finds stations broadcasting around you. The location is used for that query and nothing else.

SEARCH
Find a station by name.

—— Keep listening ——

• Background playback with lock-screen and notification controls
• Sleep timer from 15 to 120 minutes
• Favourites, saved on your device
• A dark interface with a live audio visualiser

—— Privacy and ads ——

No account. No sign-up. Radio Tune stores your favourites on the device and asks for nothing about you. Radio Tune is free and shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure those ads; the app does not track you across other apps, and where the law requires consent you are asked first and can change your choice in Settings. Crash reports and anonymous usage statistics (Google Firebase) help us fix problems; they are never used for advertising.

—— A note on the stations ——

Streams are published by third-party broadcasters through the Radio Browser directory. Availability and content are theirs, not ours: a station can go offline or change format at any time, and we do not control what is broadcast.
en.full_description:
Radio Tune is a live radio player. It opens straight to the stations people are listening to right now, and everything works without an account.

LISTEN
• Over 50,000 working stations from 241 countries, via the open Radio Browser directory
• Music, news and talk, browsable by genre tag
• Stations broadcasting near you, if you allow location
• Search any station by name

KEEP LISTENING
• Background playback with lock-screen and notification controls
• Sleep timer, 15 to 120 minutes
• Favourites, saved on your device
• Dark interface with a live audio visualiser

PRIVACY AND ADS
No account, no sign-up. Favourites stay on your device. Radio Tune is free and shows ads from Google AdMob; Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure them. No cross-app tracking, and where consent is required you are asked first and can change it in Settings. Crash reports and anonymous usage statistics (Google Firebase) help us fix problems and are never used for advertising. Location, if you grant it, is used only to look up nearby stations.

ABOUT THE STATIONS
Streams come from third-party broadcasters listed in the Radio Browser directory. Availability and content are theirs: a station may go offline or change format at any time.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Radio Tune is a live radio player. It opens straight to the stations people are listening to right now, and everything works without an account.

Intended audience:
Anyone who listens to live radio, on any device, in any country.

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No sign-in and no demo account are needed. The app opens directly on the Listen tab with live stations; Listen also has a "Near you" shelf after the optional location prompt. Browse (search, genres, countries, podcasts), Live (stations on air now) and Library (favourites, playlists, history) are the other three tabs. Settings is the gear at the top right of Listen and Library; Car mode is in Settings and the sleep timer is on Now Playing.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Radio Browser (api.radio-browser.info) — open station directory
- Apple Podcasts search (itunes.apple.com) and publishers' RSS feeds — podcasts
- Broadcasters' own stream servers — audio
- Google Firebase — Crashlytics crash reports, Performance Monitoring and Analytics (not used for advertising)
- Supabase — only to delete an account created with an earlier version
- device location services (optional, nearby stations only)
The app contains no advertising SDK and shows no ads.
- Google AdMob (ads): banner and occasional interstitial ads served by Google. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads; the app does not track users across other companies' apps or websites. Where required (EEA, UK, Switzerland) consent is requested before any ad, and the choice can be changed under Privacy choices in the app.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The interface is in English; a few shared labels follow the device language in 11 more languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNTS AND ACCOUNT DELETION
The app does not offer sign-in and cannot create accounts. Someone who signed in with an earlier version sees Settings > Account > Delete account, which deletes the account on the server; deletion is also available on the support site.
